note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as Exophase and PSNProfiles published it. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, and cites its sources; a step that cites no source is our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum has no task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Work the roadmap in order, keep the 100% grind for last, and this lands with whatever trophy you earn last.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
It unlocks on its own — there is nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this one is unmissable: play through it, follow the prompts the game gives you, and the trophy pops when the mission wraps up.
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish every objective the mission sets.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapters unlock in order, so there is nothing to hunt down here. Keep playing the main missions and this pops the moment Chapter 1 closes.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 1.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's closer. Same as the other chapter trophies: push through the main missions in order and it pops when the chapter ends.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 2.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's closer. Work the main missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 3.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's closer. Keep to the main missions and this pops at the end of the chapter — the story's home stretch starts here.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 4.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: The story's last mission, and the gold for finishing it. Our own advice: go in stocked — ammo, armour and a fast car — because a finale is a bad place to run dry.
steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, so it comes to you: take it when it appears and play it through. Our own advice: it is a good early chance to learn how the duo's missions flow.
steps: Take the Breakfast Run mission when it appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story mission. It arrives in the mission flow — play it when it opens and finish the job to pop this.
steps: Take The Cartel Heist when it appears.
Complete the heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission. Take it when it shows up in the flow and see it through to the end.
steps: Take the Child's Play mission when it appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission. It opens in the mission flow — take it and finish it.
steps: Take the Headliners mission when it appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission at the airport. Take it when it appears and finish the job.
steps: Take the VCIA Takedown mission when it appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission. It opens in the flow — take it, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Take Operation Savage Glory when it appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist is the long grind, and the gold for finishing it. PowerPyx's published 100% rules: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals, plus every robbery, underwater section, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest in full. Our own advice: leave this for last — finish the story and every other trophy first, then use the in-game checklist to mop up what is left, because the final few percent are almost always collectibles and challenges.
steps: Finish the story and the other trophies first.
Open the in-game 100% checklist and clear its remaining lines.
Hit the PowerPyx counts: 70/80 challenges, 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime, and they add up across free roam. Our own advice: chain stunt jumps off ramps and bridges while you travel anyway, and the counter climbs on its own — most players pass 250 without ever grinding it.
steps: Jump ramps, drift corners and grab airtime in free roam.
Keep it up until the counter reaches 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types, and one taste of each is enough. Our own advice: sample them as you pass them — a race here, a fishing spot there, the shooting range when you are in town — and the trophy pops without a dedicated session.
steps: Try one of each of the 9 activity types.
A race, fishing, the shooting range, a drone race, an arcade game, bowling, meditation, a stunt and a challenge cover the set.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: All 42 Shooting Range challenges, each with a gold medal. Our own advice: learn each range's rhythm before you push for gold, use the weapon the challenge hands you, and replay the ones you silver until the gold lands.
steps: Enter a Shooting Range and try its challenges.
Gold all 42 challenges, replaying any you silver.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: 14 drone race locations, a win at each. Our own advice: fly the course once just to learn the gates, then race it clean — cutting corners costs more time than it saves.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations.
Win a race at every one of them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Any 20 distinct race events count — repeat wins on the same race do not. Our own advice: work through the race list in order and tick each new one off as you win it.
steps: Enter races across Leonida.
Win 20 different race events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Cal is the fisherman to beat. Find him at a fishing spot, take the challenge, and out-fish him — steady reeling beats yanking, so keep the tension in the safe zone.
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot.
Accept his fishing challenge and beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Any arcade cabinet, played through to its end. Pick a game you enjoy — the trophy only asks that you finish one.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one arcade game to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand ends with one last mission. Follow his missions until the final one opens, then complete it.
steps: Play Andy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with one last mission. Follow his missions until the final one opens, then complete it.
steps: Play Kenton's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand ends with one last mission. Follow his missions until the final one opens, then complete it.
steps: Play Billy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Strangers show up as markers on the map, each with a short chain of missions. Our own advice: take a strand whenever you pass its marker instead of saving them all for the end — any 8 completed strands count.
steps: Find stranger markers on the map.
Complete 8 stranger mission strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with one last mission. Follow his missions until the final one opens, then complete it.
steps: Play Randy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends with one last mission. Follow his missions until the final one opens, then complete it.
steps: Play Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and read this first, because PowerPyx reports this as the game's only missable trophy: the first meditation spot is in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. Meditate there before the story moves on, or the set can never be completed. Every later spot stays available in free roam, so after that first one you can take the other 17 at your own pace.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house — do not leave it for later.
Find and meditate at the remaining 17 spots across Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
sources: PowerPyx — Bret's quests in the 100% rules
trophies.guide: Bret's quests send you after specific animals. Take one of his hunts, track the animal he names, and bring it down — one completed hunt is all this asks.
steps: Take a hunt from Bret.
Track and hunt the unique animal he names.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida in full sets. Our own advice: clear the smallest sets first — three finished sets is the target, not every card in the game.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore.
Complete any 3 full card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: The WAiNK app marks check-in spots around the map. Our own advice: open the app whenever you arrive somewhere new and check in on the spot — 100 check-ins sounds like a lot, but it stacks up quietly while you explore.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at marked locations.
Check in at 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and 50 completions across any types count. Our own advice: let the easy ones come to you while you play, then pick off the short ones — time trials and stunt challenges — to close the gap.
steps: Complete challenges of any type as you play.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Our own advice: an alley or a parking garage breaks sight fast; sit still and let the search cool off instead of outrunning it.
steps: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Rob one shop, then move to the next while the wanted level still holds — if it drops between robberies, the chain breaks. Our own advice: pick three shops close together and plan the route before you start, so the drive between them is seconds.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob two more shops back-to-back without losing it.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Every new vehicle you drive counts toward the 100. Our own advice: variety beats repetition — hop into anything you have not driven yet, even for a block, and the counter moves.
steps: Drive vehicles you have not driven before.
Discover 100 different vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus with a group clustered in front of you and drop five before it ends. Our own advice: wait until enemies bunch up in a doorway or an alley — five spread-out targets will not fall in one window.
steps: Find a spot where enemies cluster together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies in that one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave by a route that is not a scheduled flight. Our own advice: steal a plane on the tarmac and take off — the runway is the unscheduled departure.
steps: Go to VCIA.
Take a plane and leave by an unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the military's tanks, and this one is about getting mixed up with them. Our own advice: provoke a heavy military response and survive the heat — cover and a fast exit matter more than firepower here.
steps: Provoke a military response until Rhinos arrive.
Survive the encounter with the tanks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and the guards, take the goods, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. Our own advice: scout the store first, learn the patrol pattern, and only then go in — a clean run is planned, not rushed.
steps: Scout the jewelry store's cameras and guards.
Rob it without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Five separate bank vault jobs, each ending in a clean getaway. Our own advice: plan the escape before the robbery — a getaway car parked close by turns a close call into a clean exit.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape.
Repeat until you have robbed 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Ambush an armored truck, take the cash, and lose the wanted level. Our own advice: hit it on a quiet stretch of road where you control the approach and the getaway.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: All 52 areas of Leonida, visited. Our own advice: the map shows what you have seen — sweep the edges and the small towns last, because those are the areas players miss.
steps: Travel across the whole map.
Visit all 52 areas of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, one illegal operation robbed from each. Our own advice: keep a list of which gangs you have hit — the ninth one is always the gang you forgot.
steps: Find illegal operations across Leonida.
Rob one belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: A quiet moment on Ocean Beach: head to a bar there, order a cocktail, and take in the view. Our own advice: go at sunset — the view is the point.
steps: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Drive through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side, in classic style. Our own advice: pick up speed on a straight run at the showroom and aim for the glass — hesitation is what gets you stuck inside.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive through it and smash your way out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: A full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Follow through on your throws — the trophy asks for the game, not a perfect score.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling.

trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — one of the duo's shared beats. Our own advice: it comes from playing the pair's activities together, so keep the partnership in mind as you roam.
steps: Play the duo's shared activities together.
The moment lands as you play them.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: PSN tracks a count to 500 for the choices you make. Our own advice: there is no shortcut — keep playing, keep choosing, and the counter climbs with every decision, good or bad.
steps: Keep making choices as you play.
Reach 500 tracked choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed on the retry. Our own advice: this one finds you — fail a challenge or a mission attempt, then nail it second time around.
steps: Fail an attempt at something.
Succeed on the very next retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange sights — an odd event out in the world. Our own advice: poke around the weird corners of the map, the places that look like nothing is there, and something will find you.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners.
Witness a strange event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, without a gun. Our own advice: slow down as you pass, swing as you draw level, and keep rolling.
steps: Drive past someone on foot.
Strike them with a melee attack from the vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000. Our own advice: marked bills come from robberies, so this pairs naturally with the robbery trophies — launder as you go instead of saving it all for the end.
steps: Earn marked bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Any shops count, and big purchases move the total fastest. Our own advice: buy the expensive things you actually want — weapons, clothes, car upgrades — and the $100,000 takes care of itself.
steps: Spend money in shops across Leonida.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: All 8 garage properties, bought. Our own advice: garages are also useful — a place to store the rare vehicles you find for Whip It Good — so buy them as you earn the cash.
steps: Find the garage properties for sale.
Purchase all 8 of them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
sources: Our own advice, from the official description
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Our own advice: register each new vehicle the moment you find it — ten different ones is all it takes.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app near a vehicle.
Register 10 different vehicles.

roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale in order. Every story and mission trophy in this stage is unmissable — just play. One warning lives here: meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (Positive Mental Attitude), the game's only missable trophy.

roadmap.title: People and strands
roadmap.text: Finish the character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone — plus 8 stranger strands and a hunt for Bret. Take stranger markers as you pass them.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.text: Shooting range golds, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, stunts, challenges and the 18 meditation spots. Sample everything early for Master of None.

roadmap.title: Collectibles
roadmap.text: Cards, WAiNK check-ins, vehicles, areas, garages and Scooter Bros registrations. Explore as you go — the map shows what you have seen.

roadmap.title: Combat and robberies
roadmap.text: Wanted levels, shop and vault robberies, Combat Focus, tanks and gang operations. Plan each getaway before the robbery.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and 100%
roadmap.text: Money trophies, the odd one-offs, then the 100% checklist: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals. The platinum pops with your last trophy.
